info.description: API documentation for Innowise E-Commerce Solutions

Top up the authenticated user's wallet balance

get.summary: Get list of all users (admin only)

delete.description: Admins cannot delete their own account.

403.description: Forbidden (cannot delete own account or non-admin)

post.summary: Revoke the current user's API token

get.description: Returns cart items (identified by user ID for authenticated users, or session cookie for guests) along with subtotal, tax, and total.

post.summary: Add a product to the cart
post.description: Adds the given product to the cart. If the product already exists in the cart, the quantity is incremented.

delete.summary: Clear all items from the cart

put.summary: Update the quantity of a cart item
put.description: Updates quantity. If quantity is 0, the item is removed from the cart.

delete.summary: Remove a specific item from the cart

post.description: Uses POST with multipart/form-data to support file upload (category image replacement).

get.summary: Get chats (all chats for admin, own chat for user)
get.description: Admin users receive a list of all chats ordered by last message. Regular users receive their own chat (created automatically if it does not exist).

get.summary: Get a single chat with messages
get.description: Marks all messages from the other party as read.

post.summary: Send a message in a chat
post.description: Stores the message and broadcasts it via Pusher to other participants.

message.example: Hello, I have a question about my order.

post.summary: Start (or retrieve) the authenticated user's chat
post.description: If a chat for the user already exists, it is returned; otherwise a new one is created.

post.summary: Sync categories from an external API
post.description: Fetches categories from the configured external project API and imports any new ones. Pass `async=true` to queue the job instead of running it synchronously.

async.description: If true, the sync will be queued as a background job

message.example: Synced 5 new categories from external project
